identity.wallonia_link: Commanded the Arlon-based 10th Line Regiment, the formation lineage transformed into the 1st Regiment of Chasseurs Ardennais in 1933.
identity.role_fit: Belgian lieutenant-general, 10th Line commander, and Eupen-Malmedy High Commissioner; suitable senior reserve/industrial-security analogue for the alternate-history AFX Wallonia surface.
identity.role_caveat: Baltia was retired by the 1936 start and the AFX title is an alternate-history abstraction, not a claim of command over an independent Walloon state.
